findings.diagnosis: The prompt underrates the need to keep a noun or proper name tightly joined with immediately following post‑nominal material that completes identification, so it often cuts off essential modifiers (units, parentheticals, appositives, prepositional complements, relative clauses) and produces detached or misleading fragments.
